children: Japanese stocks may fall on worry over a re-escalation of the Middle East conflict, which could undermine risk sentiment. The U.S. military has been preparing a range of options to strike Iran, the WSJ reported, citing officials familiar with the planning. Also, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has been pushing publicly to restart strikes on Iran. Nikkei futures opened 260 points lower at 64515 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.11 yen versus Y158.14 around Wednesday's Tokyo market close. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 0.85% to 64621.24 on Wednesday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
